structured_output.summary: The change follows the five spec steps in order. It takes the time value with `date::this_time_value(agent, this)?`, which propagates the TypeError from RequireInternalSlot. It returns NaN when the time value is NaN, and otherwise returns `date::year_from_time(tv)` as a Number. The spec comments are kept above their code, and the unused parameters are renamed with a leading underscore. The gate shows build and clippy ok, 16/16 passing on the target with no regressions, and no lint flags. I did not read the helper functions in `support::date`, so I am assuming they implement RequireInternalSlot and YearFromTime as their names suggest.
